description: Find the LAN address a service is actually reachable on, without hand-editing an IP. Unsigned: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run.
notes: Windows SmartScreen may show an 'unrecognised app' warning the first time
you run autonet.exe. That means the binary carries no Authenticode
signature, not that anything is wrong with it. Scoop has already checked
the download against the SHA256 published with the release.
To dismiss it: More info -> Run anyway. Or clear the mark-of-the-web with
AutoNet needs no administrator rights. It reads network state and, with
'autonet advertise', sends multicast DNS on the local link. It opens no
inbound ports and changes no system configuration.
